title: Remove REST service and environment mutation endpoints

intended_behavior.rest: Service and environment mutation REST endpoints are not registered and do not mutate state.
intended_behavior.nostr: Clients use the existing Nostr control-plane reactor handlers for ServiceCreate, ServiceUpdate, ServiceDelete, EnvironmentCreate, EnvironmentUpdate, and EnvironmentDelete events.
intended_behavior.read_routes: Existing REST read routes for service and environment read models remain available for browser compatibility.

out_of_scope: Deployment, artifact, policy, tool, LLM, adoption, and direct-runtime REST deprecation work items
Implementing signer-first CLI/MCP mutation clients; tracked separately in Beads issue bahia-9sbb
